operations.title: Selector-admissible quotient kernels carry a divisibility-monotone radical resonance label
operations.body: For finite G and selector c, admissible kernels are normal K contained in Stab_R(c). With A_K=im(G->Aut(K)) and R(K)=rad(exp(K)exp(A_K)), the joint selector and power-Mackey compatible indices are U(K)={n:gcd(n,R(K))=1}. If K1 subset K2 then R(K1) divides R(K2), hence U(K2) subset U(K1).

operations.title: Nested-kernel prime-loss falsifier for the selector-admissible resonance lattice
operations.body: Falsify by exhibiting finite G and admissible normal K1 subset K2 such that a prime divides R(K1) but not R(K2). The restriction A_K2 -> A_K1 and exponent divisibility rule this out under the theorem's hypotheses.
